displayName.ja: 【パーティ】 仮面の対魔忍

profile.ja: 朧の本来の姿。フュルストによって邪悪に改造される前の朧。本名を甲河朧と言い、忍の名門・甲河家の傍系でアスカの親戚にあたる。傍系ではあるが一門の実力者でありアスカの後見人であったが、当時の対魔忍をまとめていた井河一門の長老と対立し出奔する。しかしその後、一門の集落がエドウィン・ブラック率いる一党に襲撃され一門も壊滅、アスカを人質にブラックに誘き出された朧は、アスカと引き換えにブラックに戦いを挑み敗北する。その後フュルストの手によって人体実験のモルモットとされ、対魔忍・朧に改造されて復活する事になる。……かに見えたが、朧はブラックに殺される直前に忍法・空蝉の術“心転移”によって別のものに精神を転移させて脱出に成功。その後は仮面の対魔忍としてアサギに引き取られたアスカを影から見守りながら、一門の復讐のために単身渡米し米連国内でブラックを追い続ける。その中でブラックと敵対するＤＳＯ（防衛科学研究室）と協力関係を築き、日本へ戻るとＭｉｓ.としてＤＳＯ日本支部を取り仕切り、朧同様抜け忍となったアスカを救い上げ密かに庇護している。
profile.en: Koukawa Oboro is the true form of Oboro before she was corrupted by Fürst. Her real name is Koukawa Oboro, a branch member of the prestigious Koukawa ninja clan and a relative of Asuka. Though a branch member, she was a strong figure within the clan and served as Asuka's guardian. She fell into conflict with the clan elder who led the Koukawa household's Taimanin, and left the clan. Later, the clan's settlement was attacked by a force led by Edwin Black, resulting in its destruction. When Asuka was taken hostage and used as bait, Oboro challenged Black in battle and was defeated. Fürst then turned her into a test subject for human experiments, transforming her into the Taimanin Oboro. Just before Black could kill her, she used the ninja technique "Kagerou's Mind Transfer" to shift her spirit into another body and escaped. She now operates as the Masked Taimanin, watching over Asuka from the shadows while being taken in by Asagi. She traveled alone to the United States to pursue Black's revenge, eventually forming an alliance with the Defense Science Organization (DSO) that opposes Black. Upon returning to Japan, she runs the DSO Japan branch as "Miss," secretly protecting Asuka, who has also become a rogue ninja.

text.ja: 「ふっ、驚いた顔してるわね。訳あって今日はこの衣装なの。似合うかしら？」
text.en: Heh, you look surprised. For a reason I'm wearing this outfit today. I wonder if it suits me?

text.ja: さ、これからどうしようかしら。え？　この格好が気になる？　色々あるのよ
text.en: Well, what shall we do from now on? Huh? You're curious about this look? There's a lot going on.

text.ja: 確かに露出の多いドレスではあるけれど、あまりジロジロと眺めるのはエチケット違反よ
text.en: Sure, it's a revealing dress, but staring at me like that is a breach of etiquette.

text.ja: 今は今後どう動くかに集中しなさい。状況は刻一刻と変わるのだから
text.en: Focus on how we'll move forward now. The situation changes by the minute.

text.ja: こう見えて社交界なんかのマナーは完璧なの。任務としてそういう所に潜入する時必要でしょう？
text.en: Believe it or not, I'm perfect at high-society manners. It's necessary when we infiltrate those places on a mission, right?

text.ja: ううん……いつもの仮面と少し違うからかしら、落ち着かないわね
text.en: Hmm… maybe because this mask is a bit different from my usual one, I feel uneasy.

text.ja: 普段とは違う衣装と仮面だけれど、これはこれで悪くはないのかも知れないわね
text.en: It's a different costume and mask than usual, but maybe it's not so bad after all.

text.ja: 人は心にいくつもの仮面を被っている物よ
text.en: People wear many masks in their hearts.
